correction to line 62 (αὐτὸ δικαίας διὰ πράσεως > ἀπὸ δικαίας διαπράσεως), noticed by Gascou/Keenan independently (Jim asks me to submit it on his behalf). P.Grenf. 2.71.14; P.Koeln 7.323.9; P.Lond. 2.483.29; P.Lond. 5.729.31; P.Lond. 5.1733.30, 33; P.Mich. 13.662.17; P.Michael 45.24; P.Muench 1.8.17, 1.9.97, 1.11.36, 1.12.29, 1.13.22; P.Vat.Aphrod 1.9; SB 6.8987.16, 17; SB 18.13320.24; P.Varie 15.15. For διαπράσεως, cf. P.Cair.Masp. 1.67002.8; P.Cair.Masp.1.67097.60; P.Cair.Zen. 2.59172.2; P.Cair.Zen. 3.59300.8; P.Heid. 6.379.10; P.Lond. 5.1708.148; P.Oxy.1.44.4; PSI 9.1075.5.
